mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value exceeding 200.0 indicates sustained inflationary pressure, triggering central bank rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and reduce forward returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical CPIAUCSL > 200 correlates with negative equity returns
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 4.5% signals a tight labor market with strong wage growth, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
evidence_refs: doc:Unemployment rate and equity market correlation
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000 indicate robust housing and retail consumption, accelerating economic momentum and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO declining below 105.0 reflects manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
evidence_refs: fact:Industrial production decline precedes equity market downturns
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 exceeding 11000.0 reflects robust economic output, strengthening corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
evidence_refs: doc:GDP growth and equity market performance
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 11000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
evidence_refs: fact:Rate hikes correlate with equity market declines
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS > 134000 and UNRATE < 5.0% together signal labor market strength with low unemployment, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS > 134000 and UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% define a monetary tightening cycle, where aggressive rate hikes suppress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 5-year rolling window.
